notes.subject: עלת
notes.rationale: 'olah' is literally 'that which ascends' (whole offering going up in smoke); rendered 'ofa bilong paia' — the up-going picture is partially carried by 'i go antap'.

notes.subject: altas
notes.rationale: Hebrew mizbeach means 'place of slaughtering'; Tok Pisin borrows 'altas', an added loanword, since no native word covers it.

notes.subject: ליהוה
notes.rationale: The altar is built 'to/for Yahwe' — first act of worship after the flood, marking Yahwe as the addressee of the offering.

translation: Na Noa i wokim wanpela altas bilong Yahwe, na em i kisim long olgeta ol animal bilong lukautim we i klia, na long olgeta pisin we i klia, na em i salim ol ofa bilong paia i go antap long altas.

tokens.gloss: na em i salim i go antap
